diagram_previews.alt: Square with corners 0 and 120 on the x (Alice) and y (Bob) axes. The blue band between the lines y = x + 10 and y = x - 10 is shaded and marked by an arrow as the region where the absolute value of x - y is at most 10; the corner triangles above and below the band are labelled y >= x + 10 and y <= x - 10.
